name: Rule unification: swap to published rule packages + HTML linting (B1+B2)
description:
**Repo: this repo (**`shoptet-partner-cli`). Depends on the config repo's A2 slice (packages must be published first). Source of truth: `doc/plans/rule-unification-b1.md` and `-b2.md`.

## B1 — swap ESLint/Stylelint onto the published packages

- `packages/validator/src/g3/eslint.ts` — swap `baseConfig: shoptetEslintConfig` for the published `@shoptet/addon-eslint-config`; keep `overrideConfigFile: true`; filter results through the package's `RELIABLE_RULES` named export.
- `packages/validator/src/g3/stylelint.ts` — same swap for `config: shoptetStylelintConfig` → `@shoptet/addon-stylelint-config`.
- Pin both exactly (not caret) via the `pnpm-workspace.yaml` catalog in `packages/validator/package.json`. This repo stays on eslint 10.8.0 / stylelint 17.14.1 (peer ranges `>=9.5.0 <11` / `>=15 <18` allow this).
- `docUrl` goes empty for every lint diagnostic in v1 (the config repo's rules cite catalogue codes, not URLs) — this is a golden-envelope diff, needs a version bump per `doc/versioning.md`.
- **Open decision to make in this slice**: `eslint.ts` currently reads the partner's own `eslint.config.js` for `ignores` only (a second `ESLint` instance, `isPathIgnored`, env opt-out `SHOPTET_NO_PARTNER_ESLINT_CONFIG`, latched warning `ESLINT_PARTNER_CONFIG_FAILED`); the config repo instead hardcodes an `IGNORE` list + `ignorePath: os.devNull`. Decide which stance this repo keeps.

## B2 — HTML linting

- New third engine in `packages/validator/src/g3/` alongside `typescript.ts`, `eslint.ts`, `stylelint.ts`, consuming `@shoptet/addon-html-lint` (pinned exactly), joined into the existing `Promise.all`. Checks are imported parse5 walks, never reimplemented.
- Globs `**/*.{html,htm}` minus `distDir` — broader than the gate (rooted at `src/`); this is a deliberate, documented asymmetry, not covered by the B4 rule-equality test.
- `Diagnostic.source` (`packages/manifest/src/diagnostic.ts:16-23`, currently `"typescript" | "eslint" | "stylelint" | "datalayer" | "manifest" | "shoptet"`) gains `"html"`. Requires re-running `pnpm --filter @shoptet/manifest run emit-schemas` (against built `dist/`, not `src/`) and updating golden envelopes — minor version bump minimum.
- Severity: `html/no-inline-script` and `a11y/img-alt` = error, `html/deprecated-tag` = warning.

## Hard constraint

Both sub-slices must leave `validate` linting something at every point — never a fail-green gap (this is why B1 lands before B3).

## Definition of done

A fixture project with an inline `<script>` fails `validate` with the gate's own message; ESLint/Stylelint findings come from the published packages, filtered by `RELIABLE_RULES`.
